title: 9to5
label: A corporate survival game
imageAlt: 9to5 demo showing a Windows XP-style desktop, office tasks, and career progress
description: Survive office life from a Windows XP-style desktop and work your way to CEO.
intro: A browser game about navigating toxic corporate life through a nostalgic desktop interface.
highlights: Complete office tasks while avoiding your boss.
Recover energy by doomscrolling between tasks.
Progress through management roles on the way to becoming CEO.

title: Inkboard
label: Real-time collaborative drawing
imageAlt: Inkboard landing page inviting users to start a shared drawing session
description: A shared canvas that makes live drawing with friends or teammates simple.
intro: A browser-based drawing app inspired by MS Paint and social, room-based games, designed for quick live collaboration.
highlights: Draw together on the same canvas with real-time updates.
Join room-based sessions with friends or teammates.
Pair a React client with an ASP.NET Core backend, SignalR, and PostgreSQL.

title: BudgetFlow
label: Lightweight personal finance
imageAlt: BudgetFlow dashboard showing transactions, budget categories, and available balances
description: Track spending, set category budgets, and understand where your money goes.
intro: A personal finance platform built to make everyday budgeting less overwhelming, with clear progress indicators and AI-powered insights.
highlights: Manage income, expenses, and customizable budget categories.
Track budget targets with progress bars and remaining balances.
Explore spending reports and personalized AI insights.

title: SafeBite
label: JourneyHacks 2026 · Team project
imageAlt: SafeBite restaurant discovery map with allergen filters and restaurant cards
description: An allergy-aware restaurant discovery prototype built at JourneyHacks 2026.
intro: A team-built prototype exploring restaurant discovery around dietary preferences and allergen filters, with live location data from OpenStreetMap.
highlights: Explore nearby restaurants on an interactive Leaflet map.
Filter results around 14+ common allergens and dietary preferences.
Fetch restaurant locations through the Overpass API.
Prototype limitation: allergen assignments are randomized, so ratings are not verified food-safety information.

title: Firewatch
label: Wildfire prediction & awareness
imageAlt: Firewatch wildfire-awareness app with an illustrated forest landscape
imageCredit: Screenshot background artwork: Firewatch by Campo Santo.
description: Explore wildfire risk predictions through interactive maps and environmental education.
intro: A wildfire prediction and awareness project combining machine learning, mapping, and an educational chatbot. Its visual direction is inspired by Campo Santo's Firewatch.
highlights: Search locations and view predicted fire zones on Leaflet maps.
Display model predictions with severity and confidence scores.
Train on real wildfire data, with NASA VIIRS credited as a source.
Use a Gemini-powered chatbot for wildfire and environmental education.

title: PyRin
label: 2D platformer · Work in progress
imageAlt: PyRin platformer preview with a character in a forest level
imageCredit: Character sprites: Archon_Aspect's Midnight Forest pack.
description: An unfinished 2D platformer exploring movement, collision detection, and game UI.
intro: A Python and Pygame platformer prototype with keyboard movement and jumping, mouse-driven menus, and levels built with Tiled.
highlights: Implement smooth character movement and collision detection.
Build levels with Tiled and load map data through pytmx.
Support keyboard gameplay and clickable UI controls.

title: Lucidchart Generator
label: Aether Automation · Collaboration
imageAlt: AetherGen automation dashboard listing Zoho projects with Generate Diagram actions
description: Turn structured Zoho Creator project data into import-ready Lucidchart diagrams.
intro: Co-developed a diagram-generation workflow for Aether Automation that retrieves project data from Zoho Creator and uses AI to produce Lucidchart-compatible XML.
highlights: Fetch project data from Zoho Creator through an OAuth-authenticated workflow.
Generate downloadable Lucidchart-compatible XML from project relationships and hierarchy.
Normalize structured project data for AI-powered diagram generation.
Support independent diagram generation across multiple projects.

title: Seido
label: Mountain Madness 2026 · Track winner · Collaboration
imageAlt: Seido landing page showing a guided movement session, posture feedback, and progress metrics
description: An AI-guided rehabilitation prototype with live posture feedback and session reports.
intro: Co-developed with Mike and Ryan at Mountain Madness 2026, where the project won multiple tracks. Seido explores guided movement sessions with pose detection, spoken feedback, and progress summaries.
highlights: Analyze posture and movement in real time with MediaPipe.
Provide spoken exercise guidance through ElevenLabs and Vapi.
Use Gemini to turn session data into progress summaries.
Export session reports as PDFs with jsPDF.
